payload.title: revenue widget shows this month's total
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('revenue-total')
Expected: "$128,400"
Received: "$114,900"

retries.errorHead:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('revenue-total')
Expected: "$128,400"
Received: "$121,700"

note: A specific wrong dollar figure reads like a calculation bug, but the two failed attempts land on two different wrong totals — $121,700 on the first attempt, $114,900 on the reported one — not the same wrong number repeating. A genuine calculation bug would compute the same incorrect total deterministically every run; landing on a different wrong figure each attempt matches the chart library's roughly 800ms count-up animation being sampled at a different offset each time the assertion fires, not a broken total.
